_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest). 1: one fixed step (the same difference, ×2 + the same number) or a well-known list (primes, squares and cubes in pairs); 2: a difference that grows by a fixed amount, differences that are squares or cubes, or a plain power; 3: a power with a number added or taken away (n³ + n), a step that changes as it goes (×2 − 0, 1, 2…), or two series taking turns; 4: a rule inside the digits or the fractions, or differences that follow their own rule. Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). Questions marked needs-review have none. tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
